description: Human decisions on the evidence queues, read by pipeline/merge_edges.py. contradictions: one entry per authored edge listed in contradictions.md (decision keep-authored | flip | remove | both-valid-drop-edge); a flip/remove/both-valid-drop-edge decision is applied by editing the taxonomy source files (pipeline/sources/<domain>.json), re-running the taxonomy validation, then the merge. promotions: one entry per candidate listed in promotions.md (decision promote | keep-candidate); promote takes effect only if the edge still meets the thresholds, levelBand(from) <= levelBand(to) and the path-driving graph stays acyclic. Every entry carries from, to, decision, note, date, by.
